originalFormat: glTF 1k (separate .gltf + .bin + 3 JPG textures, Poly Haven export)
processingNote: Repacked from separate glTF+bin+textures into a single-file .glb with quantaora-app/public/models/sourced/math-wave2/gltf-to-glb.mjs (copy of the in-house packer already used for chemistry-reactions/chemistry-lab-bench.glb; no geometry/material changes, images embedded as buffer views). Source glTF/bin/textures kept alongside in source-polyhaven-measuring-tape/ for reproducibility.

validation.note: Real photogrammetry/PBR scan (2868 polycount per Poly Haven's listing), diffuse + GL-normal + ARM (ao/roughness/metal) textures. Bounding box near-origin, plausible for a hand-held closed tape-measure case at meter scale (~17cm long), no corruption.

reviewNote: Passed structural/header validation only. Not yet opened in-engine or screenshotted from the actual .glb. Do not treat as visually approved.
mappedComponent: math/measurement (branch marked "detailed": false in content/taxonomy/math.json -- no authored components yet). One of this wave's named target manipulatives ("measuring tools").
notes: This is the closed/coiled tape-measure case only -- the model is static (not rigged to extend), so no tick marks/numbers are visible on the retracted tape. Genuinely identifiable as a real tape measure (worn dark-gray rubberized casing, yellow lock button, metal belt clip) but NOT usable for a 'read the measurement scale' interaction as-is; usable for a 'what is this measuring tool called' identification/compare-tray context. A second, stylized 'Measuring tape' icon asset from Poly by Google (poly.pizza id 6iaRG-ZfbeV, CC-BY 3.0) was evaluated and rejected as a redundant duplicate of this concept with lower visual fidelity (flat-shaded game-icon style vs. this asset's photoreal PBR scan, which better matches the project's clean-3D/Anatomy-Atelier quality bar per CLAUDE.md).
